dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How does one nourish the soul...?

dialogues.speaker: Zheleznov
dialogues.text: There are many ways. Reading, for instance, or listening to music... Or simply contemplating in silence, holding a calm conversation with oneself...

dialogues.speaker: Zheleznov
dialogues.text: But I should mention that, in my view, "squandering money" and "chasing after wealth" are most certainly not among them.

dialogues.speaker: Zheleznov
dialogues.text: Excessive luxury will not bring satisfaction to the soul. On the contrary, once the indulgence has passed, our souls are instead filled with emptiness.

dialogues.speaker: Zheleznov
dialogues.text: As for chasing after wealth... Hahahahaha. A purse that bulges too much can sometimes crowd out the soul, leaving no room for one's true self.

dialogues.speaker: Zheleznov
dialogues.text: Take our dear Knyazev, for example. His life was once completely consumed by both of these things. And now... heh...
